contracts: task = head*(m_tiles*n_tiles) + m_tile*n_tiles + n_tile, bijective and head-complete

DMA burst/strides identical to the executed Round83 per-head values
single FP32 L0C live across all K blocks; only kt==0 initialises (static python K loop)
no Half partial, no FP32 UB partial sum, no FP32 weight shadow, no bias operand
only the outer tile-step iteration is dynamic; the head is folded into the task index
each K block wrapped in new_stmt_scope(disable_sync=False) for the L1 WAR ordering
host pack_a zero-fills only padded M rows; pack_w keeps original Half values per head
unique build workspace per compile, artefacts copied, object SHA recorded, no path delete/move
fcntl compile lock and refusal to overwrite an existing kernel directory
module scope is stdlib only; torch and tbe are imported lazily inside functions
